## Why the current window does not cover it

Namevane stays one list of names and addresses, written to this computer's hosts file. The browser keeps the name and still checks the certificate.

These stay out: a browser extension, a local DNS server, remote rule lists, profiles, telemetry, an account, an updater, and hiding a certificate warning. If the request needs one of those, say so plainly.
